en: A sepia-toned postcard view of an old European town with cobblestone streets and historic houses in the foreground. Two people and a horse walk along the street. In the background rises a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and another tall church spire nearby. Trees and a striped pole stand near the center. At the bottom left, white printed text in German identifies the location as Meissen on the Elbe River and mentions the Freiheit (a square or street) and the cathedral (Dom).
